policy: Names are reconstructed descriptions, not recovered original symbols. Preserve expressions, operand types, layouts and native behavior. UNKNOWN means unresolved meaning, not unused.

groups.description: SpellRec::IsHelpfulOrHarmful result domain; 1 is helpful, 2 harmful, 0 undecided.
groups.evidence: IDA 0x007FE1B0 returns 1 for helpful, 2 for harmful and 0 when neither classification is established.
groups.notes: Named all result returns and matching comparisons in spell/UI/pet/visual code; kept the original int32_t signature.

groups.description: Spell_C_HandleTerrainRay result domain; preserve the three outcomes and verify caller interpretation.
groups.evidence: IDA 0x00803EE0 returns 0 for a valid ray, 1 for invalid placement and 2 beyond the preview range; CGWorldFrame consumes the same three values.
groups.notes: No range arithmetic, signature, condition or return order changed. Source value equivalence and Win32/x64 syntax passed.

groups.notes: Named default, ignore and honor modes at the property reset, native checks and all assignments in spell, unit sound and zone sound code. The int32_t field and original independent conditions remain unchanged.

groups.notes: Named SKIP_AMMO_CHECK separately from the auction inventory-filter flag in the same record.

groups.notes: Named creation-input flag at the cache provider and all five literal CreateModel callers. Kept distinct from runtime state. Source equivalence and Win32/x64 syntax checks passed across all affected units.

groups.notes: Defined the existing forward-declared SPELL_VISUAL_KIT_TYPE and reused its names at constructor, clear and delayed-kit calls, producer/consumer switches and animation checks. No field or signature changes; source equivalence passed. Win32/x64 syntax checks passed.

groups.notes: Named procedural-effect IDs and the independent four-slot count in the record, spell detection, character selection, unit dispatch and dynamic-object blizzard creation. Unresolved IDs remain UNKNOWN. Win32/x64 syntax and value-equivalence passed.

groups.notes: Added HALF_PI beside existing PI/TWO_PI using the exact original float literal. Reused these at all matching float-literal consumers; no double constants, fractions, arithmetic order or casts changed. Source equivalence and all affected Win32/x64 translation units passed.

groups.description: Extract the entry ID from a critter GUID through a named helper/mask.

groups.notes: Shared literal-type-compatible entry shift/mask names in critter, cache, chat, tooltip and combat-log paths; no helper or cast reordering introduced.

groups.description: Initial minimum-use count sentinel; use numeric_limits<int32_t>::max() or a named sentinel.

groups.notes: Named the unset-use-count sentinel while preserving int32_t and the existing minimum/fallback expressions.

groups.description: Equipment/container bag sentinel; use the matching bag-slot constant.
groups.evidence: 0x006D2A2C returns 0xFF for invalid slot lookup; 0x006DCCE4 emits 0xFF for the player bag. The identical byte has two context-specific meanings.
groups.notes: Named the invalid-slot and player-bag encodings separately across lookup, packet, equipment-manager and spell-item paths. Win32/x64 syntax and value equivalence passed.

groups.description: Spell class-mask bit count for modifier arrays; derive from mask words or a shared constant.
groups.evidence: IDA 0x007FDAFD compares class-mask bit index with 0x60; 0x00800DBF compares class-mask word index with 3.
groups.notes: Class-mask words (3), class-mask bits (96), shapeshift words (2) and forms (64) have independent schema constants. m_spellClassMask deliberately does not use NUM_SPELL_EFFECTS. Matching no-reagent-cost mask uses the word count; layout probes and Win32/x64 syntax passed.

groups.description: Rune-slot array length and loop bound.
Item spell count and loop bounds; derive from the item spell array/shared schema constant.

groups.notes: Effect slots, class-mask words and shapeshift words have independent constants. The two spell histories are named player/pet contexts; the two enchantable hands have a separate count. Remaining sizeof-based loops are self-describing; the native four-iteration vehicle loop is retained under group 26. No numeric effect/mask loop bounds remain conflated.

groups.notes: Named the limit and retained the original strict greater-than comparison. Source equivalence and Win32/x64 syntax checks passed.
